english.title: Fail to extinguish / obscure a light not required by the Road Traffic Act on entering a Mersey tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_
(C)_[a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel,]_
(D)_[a cyclist on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel,]_

(E)_[on entering the tunnel failed to extinguish or obscure a lamp not required by regulations for the time being in force under the Road Traffic Act 1988 to be carried during the hours of darkness and to keep it extinguished or obscured until the vehicle has passed out of the tunnels]_
(F)_[used full-beam headlights in the tunnel]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(m) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas OR
being a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel / on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel
on entering the tunnel failed to extinguish / obscure a lamp
not required by regulations for the time being in force under the RTA 1988
to be carried during the hours of darkness and to keep it
extinguished / obscured until the vehicle has passed out of the tunnels OR
used full-beam headlights in the tunnel
